news.title: AI mega-listings are 'just the start,' Razer CEO says, ahead of historic SpaceX IPO

insight.what: Razer CEO称AI巨头上市潮只是开始，SpaceX历史性IPO在即
insight.assets:
📈 AI科技股 利好
📈 SpaceX相关概念 利好
insight.chain: IPO热潮提升市场风险偏好（risk-on情绪），资金从防御板块轮动至成长股（高估值高潜力股票）

news.title: Oracle beats on earnings, but stock drops on plans to raise another $20 billion
news.detail: Oracle topped quarterly expectations, but free cash flow is negative, and the company plans to raise more capital for data center projects.

insight.what: Oracle财报超预期，但宣布再融资200亿美元致股价下跌
insight.assets:
📉 Oracle 股价 利空
📈 债券市场 利好（发债增加供给）
insight.chain: 增发稀释现有股东权益（每股盈利被摊薄），市场预期科技巨头将加大资本开支（capex），或推高长期利率
insight.watch: Oracle新债发行利率及认购情况

news.title: Analysis: Trump said he loves inflation. Why that should be music to Kevin Warsh's ears
news.detail: The president said Wednesday he is happy with inflation at 4.2%. That will be welcome news for new Fed Chair Kevin Warsh.

insight.what: 分析称特朗普偏爱通胀，对潜在财长Warsh有利
insight.assets:
📈 美元 看涨
📉 美债 承压
insight.chain: 通胀预期上升（物价持续涨）→美联储加息预期升温（借钱成本提高）→美元走强，风险资产承压（股票等估值受压）
insight.watch: 特朗普政策声明及CPI（消费者物价指数）数据
